== Card credits ==
Christian Knudsen is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of one card.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Set 19]], released 15 August 2022.
One card in all (Concept: 1).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Christian Knudsen|Christian Knudsen]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>

== Fan projects ==

A stickied post of 9 January 2021 on the Reddit community r/starwarsccgalters listed [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tDJC5bZ7Ul9B_-QjMXl38aw2k8trN4-R SW:CCG], a Google Drive folder of staple cards and [[Virtual cards]], under the name Chrknudsen. The post says the files were tried with Printer Studio and MPC.<ref name="mpc-post">[https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccgalters/comments/ku0xau/mpc_print_ready_cards_links_to_drives_and/ MPC Print Ready Cards - Links to drives and community disclaimer], r/starwarsccgalters, sharedmod, 9 January 2021.
